root: ^I don't know you. I don't trust you. I don't sell to you.
^The merchant steps forward, leaning down to whisper in your ear
^These people have dedicated themselves to the survival of this town. If you screw with them outsider, I will depleat my gold storage to ensure your demise.
^The merchant steps away, turning his back to you. You slink away with a fresh chill running down your spine.
